# Settling INV-USD-001 with the USD split of an HKD-quoted entry.
#
# The link itself is the ordinary one and needs no rate: the invoice is USD,
# the split holds 100.00 USD, and the settlement is what the split already
# says. The bank being in a third currency is allowed here — what the entry is
# quoted in says nothing about whether the split states the settlement.
#
# It matters on the way back out. The split's *value* is 780.00 HKD, so an
# account kept in HKD would take a figure the split already carries — and
# writing it would put HKD in a CAD book with no cost basis behind it, which
# is what `the_amount_the_new_account_takes` refuses.
#
# What this fixture produces: the split on `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD` at
# −100.00 USD, valued −780.00 HKD, in the invoice's lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unlinking_a_linked_transaction.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-04
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank HKD"
    txn_guid: "ddeeff00112233445566778899aabbcc"
    txn_split_guid: "ff00112233445566778899aabbccddee"
